Farooq Kathwari (born 1944), is a Kashmiri-American businessman and philanthropist who is the Chairman, CEO, and President of Ethan Allen Interiors.
Life
Kathwari emigrated to the United States in 1965. He has been leading Ethan Allen Interiors since 1985, and four years later he formed a group to purchase Ethan Allen from Interco, a conglomerate, and subsequently took the company public. Under Kathwari's leadership, Ethan Allen Interiors has been transformed into a leading manufacturer and retailer of home furnishings in the United States.
Personal life
Farooq Kathwari is married to Farida who is also from Kashmir. They have 2 sons, one of whom was killed while visiting Jalalabad, Afghanistan during the Afghan Civil War, and a daughter.They lives in New Rochelle, New York. He also owns a fruit farm in Columbia County, New York.
